use: top-up for countries where GLEIF has fewer usable names than the quota
attribution: none required; the project credits Wikidata voluntarily
constraints: Wikidata:Licensing (verified 2026-09-22): 'All structured data in the main, property and lexeme namespaces is made available under the Creative Commons CC0 License'
same query service limits as wikidata-people
only official names, short names, and labels are stored, with the country
format: SPARQL CSV results, one file per country, label language, and class

filters.rules: names NFC with whitespace collapsed; the label's dominant script must match its language; dropped: shorter than 3 bytes, the word LEI, duplicates of GLEIF names and of each other

split_rule: fnv1a64(0, lowercase normalized name) % 100: 0-89 train, 90-94 valid, 95-99 test; names are NFC with whitespace runs collapsed to one space
sha256_rule: over the cached files concatenated in sorted file-name order
warnings: GE has 19265 fewer organizations than the quota
